name: The Captain's Table Mint Chocolate Chip Ice Cream Sundae (Captain's Gala Night 2)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Treasure · 1923 / Disney Wonder & Magic · Captain's Gala Menu
whyItWorks: Peppermint oil in mint chocolate chip ice cream acts as a natural smooth-muscle antispasmodic, and the sundae is nut-free and citrus-free.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Pair with 1–2 Lactaid tablets; skip if peppermint relaxes your lower esophageal sphincter (reflux).
watchOuts: Peppermint can trigger GERD/reflux in some people
